title: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-5

questions.question: Rann Utsav is celebrated in which of the following states?
questions.solution: Rann Utsav is a vibrant carnival of music, dance, and culture celebrated in the White Desert of Kutch, Gujarat. It usually takes place from November to February, highlighting the traditional handicrafts and hospitality of the region.

questions.question: Deepavali is celebrated in which month of the Hindu calendar?
questions.solution: Deepavali (Diwali) is celebrated on the Amavasya (new moon day) of the month of Kartika according to the Hindu lunar calendar. It symbolizes the spiritual victory of light over darkness and good over evil.

questions.question: stad Akbar Ali Khan is remembered for his contribution to which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Ali Akbar Khan (noted as Akbar Ali Khan in some contexts) was one of the greatest masters of the Sarod. A legendary figure of the Maihar Gharana, he was instrumental in popularizing Indian classical music in the West.

questions.question: K Bijapure played which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Pandit Rambhau Bijapure was a legendary Harmonium maestro. He was known for his incredible technique and for elevating the harmonium from an accompaniment instrument to a respected solo classical instrument.

questions.question: hich music director is popularly known as ‘Pancham’?
questions.solution: R.D. Burman, the son of S.D. Burman, was affectionately known as 'Pancham'. He revolutionized Bollywood music by introducing Western influences, electronic beats, and unique rhythmic structures into the Indian film industry.

questions.question: avi Shankar is famous for which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Pandit Ravi Shankar was a global icon of the Sitar. A winner of five Grammy Awards and the Bharat Ratna, he was the most influential ambassador of Indian classical music to the world during the 20th century.

questions.question: rvind Parikh is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Arvind Parikh is an eminent Sitar player and a senior disciple of Ustad Vilayat Khan. He belongs to the Imdadkhani (Etawah) Gharana and is also highly respected as a musicologist and teacher.

questions.question: ho among the following personalities is known as the ‘Queen of Carnatic Music’?
questions.solution: M.S. Subbulakshmi is widely revered as the 'Queen of Carnatic Music'. She was the first musician to be awarded the Bharat Ratna and the first Indian musician to perform at the United Nations General Assembly.

questions.question: ho among the following is a famous music director?
questions.solution: Mohammed Zahur 'Khayyam' Hashmi, known simply as Khayyam, was a legendary music director. He is famous for his soulful, poetic compositions in films like Umrao Jaan and Kabhi Kabhie.

questions.question: ho among the following personalities is associated with the musical instrument Flute?
questions.solution: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is a world-renowned maestro of the Bansuri (bamboo flute). He is credited with bringing the flute to the forefront as a lead solo instrument in Hindustani classical music.

questions.question: ho among the following is a figure in Indian music?
questions.solution: Asha Bhosle is a legendary playback singer and a monumental figure in Indian music. With a career spanning over seven decades, she holds the Guinness World Record for the most studio recordings in music history.

questions.question: Who among the following was a popular music director in India?
questions.solution: Bappi Lahiri was a popular music director known as the 'Disco King' of India. He popularized the use of synthesized disco music in Indian cinema during the 1980s and 90s.

questions.question: The musical instrument Sarod is associated with:
questions.solution: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan is a world-famous Sarod player representing the sixth generation of the Bangash lineage. He is known for his lyrical playing style and for modifying the instrument to enhance its tonal quality.

questions.question: The name of Ustad Vilayat Khan is associated with which of the following Indian musical instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Vilayat Khan was a maestro of the Sitar. He developed the Gayaki Ang (vocal style) on the sitar, which allowed the instrument to mimic the subtle glides and nuances of the human voice.

questions.question: Zakir Hussain is associated with which musical instrument?
questions.solution: Ustad Zakir Hussain is the world's most famous Tabla player. A child prodigy and son of Ustad Alla Rakha, he has collaborated with artists across the globe and was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2023.

questions.question: Which musical instrument Dr A P J Abdul Kalam, former President of India, used to play?
questions.solution: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, the former President of India, was not only a scientist but also a lover of classical arts. He frequently played the Veena as a way to practice mindfulness and connect with Indian heritage.

questions.question: Hariprasad Chaurasia plays which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is synonymous with the Flute (Bansuri). His mastery over the instrument has earned him the Padma Vibhushan and international acclaim.

questions.question: Asghar Bal is primarily remembered for her contribution to which of the following genres of music?
questions.solution: Asghar Bai (often associated with the Dagar family tradition) was a significant contributor to Dhrupad, the oldest surviving genre of Hindustani classical music, known for its spiritual and meditative nature.

questions.question: Ramnad V Raghavan is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Ramnad V. Raghavan was a distinguished Mridangam player in the Carnatic music tradition. He was known for his mastery over rhythm and for being a prominent teacher of South Indian percussion in the United States.

questions.question: Subha Mudgal is famous for which of the following music forms?
questions.solution: Shubha Mudgal is a renowned performer of Hindustani classical music, specializing in the Khayal and Thumri genres. She is also known for her work in Indian pop and devotional music.

questions.question: The music legend Jagjit Singh is associated with:
questions.solution: Jagjit Singh was the 'Ghazal King' of India. He is credited with reviving and popularizing the Ghazal by simplifying its musical structure and making it accessible to the common masses.

questions.question: Lotia is a regional music form of which state?
questions.solution: Lotia is a soulful regional folk music form from Rajasthan. It is traditionally sung by women during the festival of Lotia, usually as they fetch water from wells or ponds, carrying decorated pots (lotas).

questions.question: Bhimsen Joshi belongs to which of the following classical music traditions?
questions.solution: Pandit Bhimsen Joshi, a Bharat Ratna awardee, belonged to the Kirana Gharana. He was a titan of Hindustani classical vocal music, known for his incredible breath control and powerful voice.

questions.question: Totaram Sharma is associated with which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Pandit Totaram Sharma is a highly respected maestro of the Pakhawaj, a barrel-shaped drum. He is one of the leading exponents of this instrument, which provides the rhythmic foundation for Dhrupad music.

questions.question: Bismillah Khan played which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Bismillah Khan was the legendary maestro who elevated the Shehnai to the classical concert stage. He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2001 and famously played at the Red Fort during India's first Independence Day.
